description: This is a Java test source file for an integration test that verifies telemetry message transmission and reception via a messaging network using JMS (Java Message Service). It tests the sending and receiving of telemetry messages in a JMS-based environment, specifically for the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: TelemetryJmsQoS1IT
classes.description: JUnit integration test class for testing telemetry message transmission over JMS in the Eclipse Hono project.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Vertx and sets up connection to the messaging network before all tests.

methods.name: printTestName
methods.description: Logs the name of each test before execution.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up resources after each test, closing consumers and disconnecting the adapter.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down shared resources after all tests have run.

methods.name: testTelemetryUpload
methods.description: Main test method that sends telemetry messages and verifies reception.

methods.name: givenATelemetryConsumer
methods.description: Sets up a JMS consumer to receive telemetry messages.

methods.name: getAmqpAdapterConnection
methods.description: Creates and connects a new JMS connection to the AMQP adapter.

methods.name: gatherStatistics
methods.description: Gathers timing statistics from received messages.
